page_title: GET 0-3 ATM | Getafe v Atletico Madrid 15/05/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+3' Mario Melero Lopez is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+1' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Gaston Alvarez (Getafe) was quite harsh and Mario Melero Lopez didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
90' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
88' Mario Hermoso (Atl. Madrid) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
88' Yellu Santiago (Getafe) has tested the patience of referee Mario Melero Lopez and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
87' Diego Simeone decides to make a substitution. Marcos Llorente will be replaced by Reinildo Mandava (Atl. Madrid).
87' Substitution. Memphis Depay (Atl. Madrid) in, Antoine Griezmann out.
85' One of the defending players blocks a long-range shot which was unleashed by Omar Alderete (Getafe).
84' Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid) shows off his amazing technique to get to the edge of the box by himself. He pulls the trigger but sends the ball into the stands. Nice run, but poor finish!
81' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) takes a short corner kick.
81' The attendance for today's match is 13027.
81' The ball is cleared after Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. Atl. Madrid get a corner.
80' The corner is swung in but Getafe can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

79' The defensive wall does its job and blocks the mid-range attempt from the free-kick by Mason Greenwood (Getafe). Getafe have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
78' Mason Greenwood (Getafe) sets the ball up and is ready to take the free kick from a promising distance. Many goals have been scored from this distance. Let's see what happens.
77' Mario Melero Lopez shows a yellow card to Jose Maria Gimenez (Atl. Madrid) for his blatant foul.
77' Substitution. Samuel Lino makes way for Saul Niguez (Atl. Madrid).
75' Rodrigo Riquelme (Atl. Madrid) is deemed to be in an offside position by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.
74' Samuel Lino (Atl. Madrid) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
73' Samuel Lino (Atl. Madrid) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
71' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.

71' Jose Angel Carmona (Getafe) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle. Atl. Madrid win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
70' Jose Bordalas Jimenez has decided to make a change. Alberto Risco Alcantara (Getafe) replaces Oscar Rodriguez.
69' Mario Melero Lopez blows his whistle as Juanmi Latasa (Getafe) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
67' Substitution. Rodrigo Riquelme (Atl. Madrid) on for Angel Correa.
65' Jose Angel Carmona (Getafe) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems.
64' A rebound sits up nicely for Yellu Santiago (Getafe), whose shot from distance is blocked by a defender.
63' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Getafe.

62' Mason Greenwood (Getafe) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Getafe will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

62' Jaime Mata (Getafe) tries to latch onto a defence-splitting pass, but one of the defending players intercepts the effort and the danger passes. The ball is out of play. Getafe will have a chance to score from a corner.
61' Jaime Mata (Getafe) is forced to stop his attacking move after the linesman signals for offside.
60' Samuel Lino (Atl. Madrid) is picked out by one of his teammates with a brilliant long-range cross, but he doesn't control the ball well and the defence eliminates the danger without any problem.
57' It is time for a substitution. Yellu Santiago (Getafe) is on for Luis Milla.
56' Angel Correa (Atl. Madrid) overhits the corner kick and none of his teammates can their head on it.
55' Omar Alderete (Getafe) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Mario Melero Lopez had an easy-decision to make.
55' A snap shot by Oscar Rodriguez (Getafe) from the edge of the area flies towards the bottom left corner, but Jan Oblak produces a good save to thwart him.

51' 0 - 3 Goal! Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) with a wonderful piece of finishing. He makes a yard for himself after a well-taken pass inside the box and strikes the ball into the bottom left corner.
50' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates as he overhits the effort.
49' Samuel Lino (Atl. Madrid) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked. The referee points to the corner flag and Atl. Madrid will take a corner.
46' Jose Bordalas Jimenez makes a switch. Juanmi Latasa (Getafe) is coming on in place of Diego Rico at the start of the second period.
46' Jose Bordalas Jimenez has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Jordi Martin (Getafe) comes on the pitch for Carles Alena.
46' Jose Bordalas Jimenez makes a half-time substitution. Jaime Mata (Getafe) comes on in place of Ilaix Moriba.
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Pablo Barrios comes off for Cesar Azpilicueta (Atl. Madrid).
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+5' Mario Melero Lopez has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+3' Mason Greenwood (Getafe) hits a dipping shot from the edge of the box that's well off target and flies miles wide of the left post.
45+3' Getafe work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
45' We will have 4 min. of added time.

42' Referee Mario Melero Lopez points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) goes wild in celebration. Goal! Samuel Lino manages to prod the ball to Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) after a melee inside the box, and he needs no second invitation to slot the ball into the left side of the goal. 0:2.
42' Attention! Referee Mario Melero Lopez straight away wants to review previous situation with VAR, presumably for a possible offside in the build-up.
42' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
40' A cross from the free kick is whipped in by Luis Milla (Getafe), but one of the defenders steps in and averts the threat.
38' Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid) is clearly in an offside position after the ball is played through to him and the linesman raises his flag.
36' A goal, which was scored by Angel Correa (Atl. Madrid), was disallowed due to offside.
33' The resulting set piece from Getafe is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
33' OFF THE BAR! Mason Greenwood (Getafe) unleashes a thunderous effort from the edge of the box and the ball crashes off the woodwork. What a strike that was!
32' Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Mario Melero Lopez saw the whole situation.

27' 0 - 1 Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) runs on to a clever pass from Rodrigo de Paul and finds himself one-on-one with the keeper. He still has work to do but finishes with aplomb into the back of the net.
25' Angel Correa (Atl. Madrid) is caught offside yet again.
24' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) and Angel Correa attempt to exchange short two-yard passes, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
21' Pablo Barrios (Atl. Madrid) tries to find Angel Correa, but he puts too much power on the pass.
19' Angel Correa (Atl. Madrid) is clearly in an offside position and the linesman raises his flag.
17' Axel Witsel (Atl. Madrid) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
17' Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
14' Diego Rico (Getafe) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
12' Some great controlled play and passing from Atl. Madrid. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
8' A crossfield pass from Omar Alderete (Getafe) fails to find any of his teammates.
7' Mason Greenwood (Getafe) dribbles his way to the edge of the box and drills a shot towards the bottom left corner, but Jan Oblak is equal to the effort and makes a good save.
5' Luis Milla (Getafe) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
5' A cross into the box from Oscar Rodriguez (Getafe) is cleared. Corner kick. Getafe will have an opportunity.
4' Samuel Lino (Atl. Madrid) is forced to stop his forward run after being caught in an offside position by the linesman.
3' Ilaix Moriba (Getafe) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are on the pitch and Atl. Madrid will have the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Mario Melero Lopez.
